newsitem.title: NORWAY: Two wounded in Norway biker shooting.
newsitem.headline: Two wounded in Norway biker shooting.

text.p: Two members of a Norwegian motorcycle gang were wounded by gunshots, one of them seriously, in the latest incident involving biker gangs in the Nordic region, police said on Thursday.

One unidentified 28-year-old man was shot in the chest inside the clubhouse of Outlaws and the other, Outlaws leader Thore Hansen, was hit in the foot outside the building in Oslo shortly after 11 p.m. (2200 GMT) on Wednesday, a police spokesman said.
"This appears to be a case of attempted murder," he told Norwegian radio.
He said five suspects were rounded up early on Thursday and would be interrogated in the morning.
News reports said one was found bleeding in a car and was escorted by police to hospital.
The spokesman declined to speculate on the reasons for the shooting but the Outlaws are associated with the bigger motorcycle gang Bandidos, which is locked in a deadly turf war with Hells Angels.
Over the past three years eight people have been killed in Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Finland in fights between the rival Hells Angels and Bandidos gangs, both offshoots of U.S. bike clans.
